post.description: OAuth 2.0 風格換發 access JWT：`grant_type=refresh_token` + `refresh_token`（form-urlencoded）。

put.description: 重設密碼：email 由信內連結的 verify_token 從 cache 取得，request body 不需傳入 email。

get.summary: Get File Info By User Id

get.description: Google 授權完成後以 GET 導回（query 帶 code、state）。與 POST /callback 行為相同，方便本機或未接前端的 redirect_uri 直接指到 BFF。

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: 先前核發的 refresh token；若為 HttpOnly cookie 則可省略，改由瀏覽器自動帶上同名 cookie

EmailSentVO.title: EmailSentVO
EmailSentVO.description: Returned by signup, email resend, and password reset email endpoints.

GoogleCallbackVO.title: GoogleCallbackVO
GoogleCallbackVO.description:
Returned by /callback. auth_type is SIGNUP or LOGIN.
For LOGIN, user is populated. For SIGNUP, ttl_secs is populated.

ResetPasswordBodyDTO.title: ResetPasswordBodyDTO
ResetPasswordBodyDTO.description: Request body for PUT /auth/password/reset. Email 由 verify_token 從 cache 取得，不經由 client 傳送。
